craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at measurelessness. Device: end-dash→comma (measuring softens), mid-dash→colon (hail lands). Bright: mote, mountain, egg, Pillar — measure glowing. Rejected: 'grain/summit' rhyme — killed: slant smuggles doctrine; vocative 'O Pillar' — killed: dative offering, and hail already carries address. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Finer than the sacred-syllable half-mora crown — to mote and mountain both,
wider than the world-egg: hail the traitless-traited, the Pillar.
l4.sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Than praṇava's upper half-mora even, to the minute, again to the great.; Than the world-egg even: to qualityless-qualified, to Sthāṇu — bow. → Bow to Sthāṇu beyond measure, minute and great, qualified by qualitylessness.
c1_essence: Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: Subtler than praṇava's upper half-mora — to the minute, and again to the great; vaster than the world-egg — to the qualified-by-qualitylessness, to Sthāṇu: bow.
l2.sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ
